Tecaca
Eww... He looks strange just as what we heard.\nAnyway, let's talk to him.\nHey! Are you Tecaca?
...Agh, who called me?\nDon't disturb my sleep.\nIt's not open yet. Get lost...
What?! Are you really a merchant?\nWhy are you running a store in such a place?\nAnd why isn't it open? It's almost noon! And...
Whoa?! You smell like alcohol! ...Anyway,\nYou sell holy gems, right?\nWe came here to ask something about it.
What huh? Holy gem?\n...Hey, you're a Cule merchant. I won't sell you\nthe gems. You guys resell for big profits!
Tsk, you saw through my ruse...Oops!\nI mean the person who wants to ask you about\nthe holy gems is this adventurer, not me!
Tsk, you saw through my ruse...Oops!\nI mean the person who wants to ask you about\nthe holy gems is this adventurer, not me! You see?
You asked where holy gems are made.
Where they are made?\nAh, you're a Straye adventurer?
Hmm, then I can tell you but...\nCan you do me a favor?
Wow, I haven't explained about it. But you said yes?\nYou've got guts. Very well!
Then, come back with the [ffff64]Proof of Victory [ffffff] from\nMauez the Moon Wizard in New Moon Palace.\nShould be easy for Straye adventurers.
Okay, I'll stay here and pray for your...
Forget it, I'll go with you!\nWait for me!
Go for it guys! Ha ha!
After all your efforts...\nTecaca isn't here. Could it be...
HE TRICKED US!!
Tecaca is sleeping...
Let's go to New Moon Palace...
Tsk, what the heck. What a waste of effort...\n*sigh* It's just like what Grandma said...
...Huh? ...That's right.\nIt's no use complaining...\nAlright! Let's go find Tecaca again!
This is driving me nuts. At a time like this,\ngoing back to basics is the best!\nLet's go see Tolala again.
You'll be in trouble without me, right?\nWell, I'll go with you a little longer…
